data.name: Drishansh
data.long_meaning: Drishansh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Drish', which means 'to see' or 'to observe'. The name Drishansh is a compound of 'Drish' and 'Ansh', which means 'manifestation' or 'symbol'. The name signifies the ability to see beyond the obvious and into the deeper meaning and symbolism of things.

Those with the name Drishansh are believed to have a deep connection to their spiritual selves and a strong ability to perceive the world around them.
